# ClaudeMC v1.16.0

## AutoMine — Evasion Overhaul

The staff-detection response in AutoMine was completely rewritten:

- **Random break instead of freeze** — when AntiAFK signals staff nearby, AutoMine now takes a
  random 1–60 second break (no movement, no mining) then resumes. A complete freeze was obviously
  suspicious; a short random pause looks like a player stopping to check their phone.
- **Look-lock during break** — yaw and pitch are held still throughout the break. Previously the
  module looked around during the pause, which looked exactly like an xray scan.
- **Elevated miss chance post-detection** — after a staff check, miss chance is raised to ≥ 55%
  for 10 minutes, making the bot look more like a cautious human player.
- **Ore spawn detection** — if 3+ new ores appear within ~6 blocks in under a second (typical of
  staff teleporting in ores to bait xray clients), they are classified as staff-placed:
  - Ores off your current mining axis are **ignored entirely** — no looking toward them.
  - Ores directly in your tunnel path are mined naturally if you walk into them; after mining
    an abnormally large vein (≥ 3 consecutive), the module performs a brief surprise
    look-around (random yaw/pitch nudges over ~25–65 ticks) mimicking a player reacting.
- **Vein look-around** — independent of staff detection, any vein of ≥ 3 consecutive ores
  triggers the surprise look-around behaviour with 65% probability.

## ServerFinder

New module (Misc → `ServerFinder`) that queries [mcscans.fi](https://mcscans.fi) for live
Minecraft servers and filters them two ways:

- **Vulnerable mode** — matches server version/MOTD strings against VulnDb. Flags unpatched
  Spigot, CraftBukkit, BungeeCord, Waterfall, Mohist, and Magma builds as well as known
  vulnerable plugins.
- **P2W mode** — matches server IP/MOTD against a curated list of servers publicly identified
  as pay-to-win or containing gambling mechanics targeting minors (crate keys, OP spawners for
  sale, /fly for cash, etc.).
- **Both mode** (default) — runs both scans.
- **AI-enhanced P2W list** — when an AI key is configured, the AI is asked to produce a
  broader P2W/gambling server list, backed by a DuckDuckGo web search.

Settings: `Mode` (Both/Vulnerable/P2W), `UseAI` (default on), `MaxResults` (5–100, default 20).

## VulnDb — Extended

14 new vulnerability entries added, covering:
GriefPrevention claim bypass, AdvancedEnchantments dupe, ItemsAdder dupe, SuperiorSkyblock bank
race, AuthMe hash collision, NuVotifier vote abuse, Skript eval injection, PlaceholderAPI info
leak, ChestShop lag dupe, Citizens2 command injection, Multiverse bypass, CoreProtect desync,
PlayerShops race, Votifier unauthenticated.

## Anti-P2W / Cracked Utilities

Four new Misc modules inspired by the anti-P2W Meteor addon:

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| **ForeachCmd** | Runs a configurable command once per online player (with `%player%`) or N times (with `%i%`), with random tick delays between executions to avoid spam detection. |
| **AutoAuth** | Detects login/register prompts from AuthMe, NLogin, FastLogin, and JPremium and sends your password automatically. |
| **BookColors** | Static utility that translates `&x` colour codes into Minecraft `§x` format — available for use in book text. |
| **AutoReconnect** | Saves the last server address on disconnect and reconnects automatically after a configurable random delay. Optionally rotates to an offline alt before reconnecting. |
